definitions.explanation: Describing behavior, expression, or content that is openly displayed without any attempt to conceal or soften it. Often carries a negative connotation, suggesting something that should be restrained or hidden is being shown too openly.

examples.japanese: {露骨|ろこつ}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{露骨|ろこつ}な⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えていて→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{不快|ふかい}→不快：11386_fukai⟧だ。
examples.english: The blatant advertising on social media has been increasing recently and it's unpleasant.

notes: Used both as a na-adjective ({露骨|ろこつ}な) and as an adverb ({露骨|ろこつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). Almost always carries a negative connotation — something is being shown too openly or crudely. Common collocations: {露骨|ろこつ}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (explicit expression), {露骨|ろこつ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (undisguised attitude), {露骨|ろこつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{嫌|いや}がる→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧ (openly show dislike). Can describe sexual content ({露骨|ろこつ}な⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧, explicit depiction), discrimination, or any behavior that lacks subtlety.
